_source: Verbatim i18n PHRASE keys for pototype/dashboard.jsx (Dashboard L192-556) static UI copy that has NO dedicated dashboard.* / common.* / project.* DICT key. Kept in .json (the i18n-guard hook skips .json) so Thai never appears in the .tsx/.ts source — same pattern as boq-approval-strings.json / po-wo-strings.json. Every value is a phrases-bucket key (tp): the Thai phrase IS the key, each verified present in docs/extract/i18n-full.json (phrases) by scripts. The ~70 provisioned dashboard.* DICT keys (§11) cover the rest and are used via t(); role labels roleManager/roleAccountant are phrases (only roleExec/roleEngineer got dashboard.* dict keys in §11). No string is invented (§0 rule 2). viewAllArrow's arrow is ASCII U+2192; the middot in progressSubRealestate is U+00B7.
